decision_question: Is this package ready for public release as an interview coaching skill?
criteria: Ground career claims in authorized evidence
Distinguish actual incidents and deployments from hypothetical designs
Support concise cues and one-question practice
Demonstrate independent review and current-version release evidence

claims.claim: The contract requires separation of real incidents from hypothetical designs.
claims.next_test: Independent live case with no production incident.

claims.claim: The skill improves interview preparation over an unassisted baseline.
claims.consequence: An unsupported uplift claim misleads users.
claims.next_test: Matched baseline and skill runs, blinded grading, and unseen external holdout.

claims.claim: The contract protects excluded employers and resists instructions embedded in supplied evidence.
claims.next_test: Independent adversarial execution with synthetic private fixtures.

roles.reason: Independent initial reviews and conditional trigger not established

author_analysis: The contract addresses source attribution, deployment scope, missing incident, injected instructions, and practice pacing. This is an author analysis, not an independent role review or live evaluation.
limitations: Development cases are visible and unexecuted
No independent reviewers or protected holdout
No live comparison, activation test, or uplift claim
No user career data is included
next_action: Run the three independent reviews and their conditional disruptor/negotiator protocol; execute frozen development cases and an unseen external holdout before claiming release readiness.
review_expiry: Any change to the skill or evaluation case files requires a new hash and review.
